sources.entry: Iconology - Edit icons and then export to Xcode, icns, ico, favicon, macOS iconset, or a custom collection.

summary.one_liner: Iconology is a native macOS app for importing, editing, and exporting app icons and image assets in formats such as Xcode asset folders, .icns, .ico, favicons, and macOS iconsets.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a macOS app for importing an image, editing it, and exporting it in many icon formats. Export targets include Xcode, iOS, macOS, Message, and Apple Watch icon sets, plus special files such as .icns, .ico, image sets, Mac iconsets, favicons, and PNGs of any size. Users can also create custom export presets. The built-in image editor offers background color, scaling, horizontal and vertical shift, a non-stretching aspect ratio editor, rounding (circular, continuous, and squircle), drop shadows, and padding. The README says it accepts .png, .jpg, .ai, .psd, .pdf, raw, and other formats. It also says Xcode export produces JSON so a folder can be dragged into Xcode.
use_cases: Generate app icon sets for Xcode projects
Make macOS 11+ style rounded app icons
Batch-produce PNGs of multiple sizes from one source image
Resize and pad a logo onto a background color
notable: Exports directly into Xcode-ready JSON and asset folders
Covers icns, ico, favicon, and macOS iconset formats in one tool
Squircle, continuous, and circular rounding modes for macOS 11+ icons
Custom export presets for user-defined icon sizes
caveats: Works only on macOS, as the README describes a 100% native macOS UI
README does not state installation steps or a release link
